title: Fix Linux build setup
body: ### Summary - Add missing direct standard-library includes required for the Linux Clang build. ### Validation - `cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug` succeeds after installing the README-listed Linux development packages plus matching `g++-14` standard library support for Clang 18. - `cmake --build build --target JoyShockMapper --parallel 2` succeeds and produces `build/JoyShockMapper/JoyShockMapper`. - Runtime launch reaches virtual input initialization, but the Cursor Cloud kernel lacks the `uinput` module, so JoyShockMapper aborts with `Failed to create virtual device: No such device`. This matches the README requirement for RW access to `/dev/uinput` and `hidraw` devices. ### Artifacts - Build log: [joyshockmapper_build_success.log](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-d1e3f58f-b2f4-47a5-8246-74e12066fac3/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fjoyshockmapper_build_success.log) - Runtime log: [joyshockmapper_runtime_uinput_failure.log](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-d1e3f58f-b2f4-47a5-8246-74e12066fac3/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fjoyshockmapper_runtime_uinput_failure.log) - Kernel/device check: [joyshockmapper_uinput_check.log](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-d1e3f58f-b2f4-47a5-8246-74e12066fac3/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fjoyshockmapper_uinput_check.log) To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.
